title: Private preview10 preserved baseline
content: The desired stable-first candidate is Satellite Center 0.3.0~preview10. Its preserved application source/archive and verification ledger are private, not checked into this public repo. This public repo started empty and now contains documentation only.

title: Supported intended app modules
content: Design includes Receiver/Planner, Images & Data, Earth/Sky, Signal Analysis and Auto-Capture & Decode. The target is native desktop on Pop!_OS with optional web mode and offline-first behavior; the UI needs device ownership and hard-stop safeguards.

title: Satellite formats and signals
content: Feature targets include ISS SSTV, NOAA APT/Meteor LRPT reception and WAV/CU8/BOTH capture where supported. Prior incomplete captures do not prove image decoding works. Do not claim actual hardware success without raw evidence.

title: Public/private source boundary
content: Do not publish frozen binaries or source snapshot from private evidence, recordings, location metadata or user files in this public repository. Only metadata reviewed for public disclosure belongs here. A separate user-web installation also must remain untouched.

title: Unverified acceptance scope
content: Private evidence describes scoped archive checker and disposable transaction tests, but the public repository has no executable source or verified installation. Independent QA, licensing and real RTL-SDR pass/capture acceptance are pending. Public release HOLD.

title: Next safe Codex mission
content: First inspect this docs-only repository and consult private evidence only when separately authorized; verify source rights and stable snapshot mapping before proposing code changes. Never replace the user's installed preview10 or upload private artifacts.
